title.zh: Core Scientific, Once the Largest Bitcoin Miner, Plans to Fully Shut Down Bitcoi
title.en: Core Scientific, Once the Largest Bitcoin Miner, Plans to Fully Shut Down Bitcoi

current_state.zh: Core Scientific announced it is accelerating the shutdown of its Bitcoin mining operations, targeting a complete exit by Q4 2026 while pivoting to high-performance computing colocation, with Q3 colocation revenue reaching $215 million.
current_state.en: Core Scientific announced it is accelerating the shutdown of its Bitcoin mining operations, targeting a complete exit by Q4 2026 while pivoting to high-performance computing colocation, with Q3 colocation revenue reaching $215 million.
